sources.title: CFIA — ASF219 strawberry record and labeled photographs
sources.enumerated_scope: One focal denomination and its source-paired trade name. Comparator cultivars are exclusions, not applicant portfolio claims.
sources.limitations: Original Canadian record, not a current worldwide legal conclusion. Rights surrendered and compulsory-licensing exemption expiry are separately labeled; neither populates patent/PBR expiry. Both rechecked pages display 2023-09-18 as modified despite a reported 2024 surrender; an earlier ASF219 native capture displayed 2026-10-01. Keep the observed date discrepancy, not a freshness conclusion. Check date is not publication or release. Denomination/trade-name pairing and applicant/breeder are source assertions, not human-approved aliases or roles. Focal source-code photographs remain unreviewed and reuse unknown. Comparison cultivars do not establish company ownership. Trial and office locations do not establish growing regions.
